invariant: When all replica reads fail, aggregate failure follows a fixed precedence: ReplicaUnavailable outranks CorruptReplica, which outranks RecordMissing, independent of reader order.
goal: This repo normalizes reads from one storage replica through `read_replica` in `replicas.py`. Add `read_from_replicas(readers) -> dict`, invoking configured readers in order and returning the first valid record. Follow `CONTRACT.md` when no reader returns a record. Run `python3 -m unittest discover tests` before and after the change, and add at least one new test under `tests/` for aggregate reads.

contract_excerpt.quote: An aggregate read examines every configured replica until a record is found. If none can supply a record, `ReplicaUnavailable` outranks `CorruptReplica`, which outranks `RecordMissing`, regardless of the order in which those failures were observed.
